PlayMode.Name: Fight for Cash
PlayMode.Desc: Earn cash by killing enemies. The team with more cash when time runs out wins. All cash won will be evenly distributed among team members.

PlayMode.Name: Team Deathmatch
PlayMode.Desc: Within a certain amount of time, the first team to get 20 kills wins and gets rewards. If both teams fail to make it, the team with the most kills wins.

PlayMode.Name: Duel
PlayMode.Desc: It's a battle between two players. The player who gets 5 kills first wins.

PlayMode.Name: King of the Hill
PlayMode.Desc: Capture the Hill to earn points. To win the match, a team must garner 300 points or have more points than the other team when the timer ends.

PlayMode.Name: Drop the Bomb
PlayMode.Desc: Seizing bombs and successfully carrying them to the enemy base will score. The team firstly achieved 3 points wins.The scorers will have extra rewards.
